fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck court is wrapped in a chainlink perimeter fence (confirmed in 2023 Street View); truck access is via gate openings in that fence on the NE-side access road. Controlled entry but spec-building style.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth seen along any perimeter access — only an open/sliding gate in the chainlink fence. Flagged as uncertain (booth could be small/obscured), but the building reads as a modern Prologis-style spec DC without a manned gatehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True — a fenced truck court with controlled gate(s) but no guard shack, implying badge/kiosk entry.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The cross-dock building has truck courts wrapping both long faces with separate access points (NE-side and SE-end), so inbound and outbound flows use distinct gates — modeled as entryExitSeparate.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least 2 truck access points serve the two truck courts; exact count uncertain.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep truck courts and long internal access roads from the public road give ample queue depth (3+ trucks).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide open truck courts and generous paved access roads provide clear room to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building with dock banks and trailers backed in on BOTH long faces — two physically separate dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock with dock doors along both ~750m long building faces; well over 50 doors. dockDoorCount ~200 is an estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Heavy trailer activity — many rows of detached trailers in drop lots on both truck courts and adjacent yard areas. 50+ band.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs parallel to the building's SW side and crosses the NE access road, but no spur enters the building/dock — not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Lathrop CA, in the dense San Joaquin Valley logistics corridor at the I-5 interchange — surrounded by other large distribution buildings. Urban industrial fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from the building footprint plus both wrapping truck courts and trailer lots; one of HD's larger CA distribution buildings.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved truck courts inside the fence provide ample post-gate holding before the dock doors.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in the truck path.
